pages.text: Magical Wood boosts an enchanting table when placed in a valid bookshelf position. It gives 2.5 enchanting power per effective block. Craft it from a bookshelf, gold, and a Bottle o’ Enchanting, or make it in the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:machines/enchanter)Enchanter$(/l).

pages.title: Ferrous Juniper
pages.text: Ferrous Juniper Log and Planks are decorative blocks available in Creative. Use a stone axe or better to collect them. No trees or recipes produce these blocks in the bundled survival progression.
